marta-sales: Heads up  Prospect: AtlasLedger wants a short POC next week. Scope: Okta SSO (SP-initiated), SCIM user+group sync (bulk + delta), RBAC mapping from groups, and domain claims for multiple subdomains across two DNS providers. They sent a security questionnaire and asked about Dedicated trial pricing. Need quick confirmations on SCIM behavior, domain claim multi-zone approach, delegated admin rights, and what we include in the security packet. @ben-se @omar-eng

ben-se: Ack. High-level: SAML SP-initiated supported; we can ingest IdP metadata URL or XML. SCIM 2.0 supported: bulk import endpoint for initial seeding + PATCH-based delta for incremental updates. Group-to-role mapping is supported and can be paired with a group allowlist to limit provisioning.

omar-eng: SCIM specifics: delta uses PATCH operations and our delta webhook exposes only changed resources. For POC best practice: 1) use bulk import to seed users (paged), 2) enable delta webhooks for live changes. Default hosted SCIM throttle is 60 req/s; ops can temporarily raise this for a POC window. Example minimal PATCH we accept: 

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op": "replace", "path": "active", "value": true},
    {"op": "replace", "path": "groups", "value": [{"value": "eng-team","display": "Engineering"}]}
  ]
}
```

omar-eng: Also note: if Okta includes many groups in the SAML assertion, assertion size can spike. For large orgs prefer SCIM group sync.

sophia-ops: Domain claims: we generate a TXT token per domain/subdomain. For subdomains that live under the same parent zone we can optionally provide a consolidated TXT (ops approval required) which the customer places once; this can speed multi-subdomain verification. If subdomains are in different DNS providers/zones we need separate TXT entries. We explicitly do not support wildcard apex verification. Verification usually completes within minutes after DNS propagation; allow a safety buffer of 24h. We can run verification checks for them if given delegated DNS readonly access or they paste the TXT values in a secure channel.

marta-sales: Delegated admin question: can customer create tenant-scoped admins who manage SCIM and domain claims?

ben-se: Yes  tenant-scoped delegated admins are supported. For Dedicated/Private they can manage SSO settings, SCIM toggles, group allowlists, and initiate domain claim requests. For Hosted we allow tenant admins but sometimes final verification is run by our ops team depending on the verification method they choose.

elain e-legal: Security packet checklist: SOC2 Type II report summary, pen test executive summary, encryption-at-rest + KMS note, network isolation whitepaper (for Dedicated), SAML metadata endpoints and list of attributes we typically require, SCIM scope/retention policy, and our standard DPA. If they return their completed questionnaire we'll mark items that need legal redlines and escalate. If they request an ISA/contract redline, that's a separate legal task.

omar-eng: Ops caveat: watch for nested groups and Okta flattening behavior. Also, if they try to bulk sync very large groups in a single call, prefer smaller page sizes to avoid timeouts.

sophia-ops: Pricing options: 1) Hosted with elevated quotas + credits (fast), or 2) short Dedicated trial with reserved capacity. For the AtlasLedger expected POC load (~150k tokens/day, moderate concurrency) ballpark Dedicated POC pricing: $2,700/week. I'll pull an exact quote from sales-ops and propose options for Hosted credits. :money_with_wings:

marta-sales: Perfect. I'll ask them to provide IdP metadata (XML/URL), a sample SAML assertion, a test SCIM token and one test user, list of domains + DNS provider info, and their filled security questionnaire. Also scheduling: can we do a kickoff Wed 10am?

calendar-bot: Created invite "AtlasLedger POC - SSO & SCIM kickoff" Wed 10:00 AM (30m) with #sales, @ben-se, @omar-eng, @elaine-legal.

marta-sales: Thanks all  I'll send the checklist and follow up with a formal quote by EOD. :thumbsup:
